body:
Two small table changes:

- **Default extensions.** `glue` and `legacy_parser` are built and distributed with every release (`core.cmake`, `cloud.cmake`) but were missing from the default extension table in `extension_helper.cpp`, so `duckdb_extensions()` did not list them until installed.
- **Autoload.** glue's functions, settings and external-resource types were already in the autoload tables of `extension_entries.hpp`, but `CanAutoloadExtension` refused the extension itself because it was not in `AUTOLOADABLE_EXTENSIONS`. Added there and in `scripts/generate_extensions_function.py`, which generates the header.

The second commit is separable if autoloading glue is not wanted yet.
title: List glue and legacy_parser among the default extensions, let glue autoload
